statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit. Requested host redirects permanently to moviesda33.com; representative templates were audited on the final host.

page.notes: Public movie directory/download site. Requested moviesda32.com redirects to moviesda33.com.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared screenshots under default and emulated dark color scheme.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The light and dark-condition screenshots are pixel-identical (75,258 bytes each); surfaces remain light under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and inspected document animations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Runtime probe found 0 active animations on the representative home state under reduced motion; audited templates expose no auto-advance or essential motion.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and Lighthouse contrast results.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule is authored, and Lighthouse found multiple contrast failures, including Page Tags at 2.7:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered CSS and navigated listing to detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation across the MPA templates is an abrupt full-document swap; authored CSS contains no view-transition rule or @view-transition declaration.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and page interactions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the representative templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site has no scroll-linked motion to implement.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM and representative interactions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited templates contain ordinary links and forms, with no swipe, drag, pull, carousel, or gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed full-page mobile screenshot, layout height, and CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 4,253px mobile home page has no sticky navigation, progress indicator, or scroll-state response; the header simply scrolls away.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection across representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, menu, or other anchored overlay exists in the audited templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no overlay requiring anchor positioning.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM landmark probe and visual journey review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: There is no nav landmark or current-location cue, and directory-to-detail navigation changes pages without a focus/visual transition cue.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed initial-load screenshots on all representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Load screenshots show no modal, interstitial, cookie wall, or full-viewport overlay obscuring content.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection across templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No disclosure, modal, transient overlay, or rich custom control requiring dialog, popover, or details is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No overlay or disclosure UI exists.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed mobile screenshots and DOM content hierarchy.
checkOutcomes.evidence: On mobile, repeated branding, Telegram copy, bookmarking prompt, and search consume roughly the first 339px of an 800px viewport before page-specific content; pages also append keyword-stuffed tags.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran layout primitive at a 360x800 viewport on home and listing.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360x800, home and listing report scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360, horizontalOverflowPx 0, with a valid viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered authored CSS across templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS uses viewport media queries and fixed control dimensions but no authored @container/container-type rules, so reusable components do not adapt to their containers.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused a link and measured interactive element rectangles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Keyboard focus uses the browser outline, but many primary text links have only 17px-high hit areas, well below comfortable touch-target guidance.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-viewport screenshots and heading/link text.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first viewport identifies Moviesda and provides a prominent search; category and listing labels make the download purpose explicit.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked the primary browse-to-download journey through representative pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative movie path requires sequential listing -> title -> Original -> resolution directory steps before a file action, adding avoidable detours and repeated site chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a nonexistent path and submitted the request form empty.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A nonexistent route redirects to /movies.php and serves an index-like page rather than a truthful 404 or recovery explanation; invalid form submission relies only on native browser UI with no persistent error summary.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse mobile performance audit and trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 4,006ms (score 0.49), outside the good <=2.5s range, although CLS was 0 and TBT 4ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran layout observers and Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout observers on home and listing recorded CLS 0 and no shifts; Lighthouse also measured CLS 0.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured a DevTools trace and Lighthouse metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace recorded 0 long tasks and 0ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 4ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, confirmed stylesheet placement in DOM, and ran Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR confirms two parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheets, including a Google Fonts @import; Lighthouse LCP is 4.0s and BFCache is blocked by no-store caching.

checkOutcomes.method: Analyzed HAR totals and third-party weight.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties transfer 192,294 of 208,379 bytes; Google Tag Manager alone is 166,828 bytes on a mostly static page.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and inspected the button markup.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found the search button visible text “Search Movie” does not match its accessible name “Submit search”.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color-contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple WCAG contrast failures: search button 3.67:1, red tags 3.79:1, and Page Tags 2.7:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected headings/landmarks and keyboard focus style.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home has no nav landmark, and listing/detail/request templates use styled divs for page titles rather than h1 headings; focus is visible but structure is incomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed mobile screenshots and computed CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile screenshots show unclipped body copy with 1.5 line-height, readable wrapping, and no horizontal clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured targets and tested 360px reflow.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport allows scaling and reflow has no overflow, but many links measure only 17px high, making touch targeting cramped.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit scored 1 with no error items.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected document metadata and ran images primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but the repeated folder SVG lacks width/height attributes; images primitive flags missing dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices and BFCache audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons caused by Cache-Control: no-store and reports DevTools inspector issues.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected raw/rendered DOM metadata across templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, listing, detail, and request templates each expose descriptive title and meta-description elements in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchors, robots.txt, and viewport metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport and robots are valid, but visible Telegram Channel and active pagination/0-9 controls use href="#", which is not a crawlable destination.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical metadata, redirect headers, sitemap, and missing-route behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public pages have no rel=canonical; the requested moviesda32.com permanently redirects to moviesda33.com, and nonexistent paths redirect to an index page rather than return 404.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected metadata on representative movie detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Movie detail pages provide basic Open Graph text but no JSON-LD entity data and no social preview image.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers and cookies primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran trackers and HAR primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The static page contacts six third-party origins, including Google Analytics and an opaque advertising script; third parties account for 92% of transferred bytes.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM/scripts and representative flows.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No authentication surface or browser permission request exists on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authentication or permission-requesting feature is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected security headers and Lighthouse cookie audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The response lacks HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; Lighthouse additionally observed third-party cookies.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran discoverability primitive with JavaScript-on/off comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability comparison reports 100% raw-HTML coverage, isJsShell false, with title, h1, and description present without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM and exercised representative navigation/form states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative pages are simple server-rendered documents with native forms and links; no cut-off overlay or fragile async UI was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed manifest and service-worker state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No app manifest or service-worker controller exists, but this public directory/download site is document-oriented rather than an installed application.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline installability is not necessary for this document-oriented site.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested and captured a nonexistent route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing URL is redirected to /movies.php and presented as a successful content index, with no not-found explanation or recovery context.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected HTML language/direction and authored CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang="en" matches the English UI, but no dir is declared and CSS mixes a few logical properties with many physical left/right margins and paddings, limiting bidi readiness.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected visible data and DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative pages show movie years but no locale-sensitive dates, numbers, currencies, or durations.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive data formatting is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected visible content and DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited pages expose no event times, schedules, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive values.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected visible labels and href targets.
checkOutcomes.evidence: “Join our Telegram Channel” is a dead href="#" control, while the footer “Disclaimer” also links to home; these labels promise destinations they do not provide.

checkOutcomes.method: Submitted the request form with an empty required textarea.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The request form uses associated labels and required constraints; empty submission focuses the invalid Message textarea using native validation.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected request-form controls and autocomplete attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only authored request inputs are a subject select and free-form message textarea; no address, payment, sign-in, or identity fields need autofill tokens.
checkOutcomes.reason: No structured personal or transactional input requiring autocomplete is collected.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative paths and forms.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, or account-management flow exists on the audited site.
checkOutcomes.reason: No commercial or account flow is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran HAR and images primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transfers only 4.3KB of images; repeated folder art is SVG and no raster media dominates the load.

checkOutcomes.method: Analyzed HAR by origin/resource type and tracker inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A static directory page loads analytics and an opaque ad script; third-party JavaScript accounts for 166.8KB while first-party transfer is only 16.1KB.

checkOutcomes.method: Analyzed HAR third-party budget.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Five third-party requests transfer 192.3KB of the 208.4KB total, disproportionate to the core static content.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected robots.txt and DOM capabilities.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site is a public content directory with no transactional agent-facing capability; robots.txt explicitly disallows major AI agents.
checkOutcomes.reason: Emerging agent-tool exposure is not applicable to this content directory.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative features and scripts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, or other inference task is part of the site experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no user task that warrants on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and interaction inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site is an MPA of static documents with no modal, route-state, feed, editor, or other representative in-page interaction to repeat ten times.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no real repeated in-page interaction; fabricating one would not test product behavior.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured heap summary and runtime memory/DOM metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap snapshot totals are 3,884,008 self-size bytes; runtime JS heap used is 4,472,092 bytes with 225 DOM elements, proportionate for the page.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected heap constructor summary and page scripts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The heap summary contains no Detached* constructor population; the static MPA does not install recurring UI interactions.

principleOutcomes.reason: Emerging agent-tool exposure is not applicable to this content directory. There is no user task that warrants on-device inference.

paths.description: Entry/home template and initial search/discovery surface; includes desktop/mobile, preference, performance, security, crawler, and memory conditions.
Representative category/listing template, including pagination and mobile reflow.
Representative movie journey through title and resolution-selection templates.
Primary user-authored request form, including empty invalid submission.

findings.evidence: The light and dark-condition screenshots are pixel-identical (75,258 bytes each); surfaces remain light under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define system-selected surface/text colors with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(). See Modern Web Guidance: dark-mode.

findings.summary: Support high-contrast preferences and fix contrast
findings.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule is authored, and Lighthouse found multiple contrast failures, including Page Tags at 2.7:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast handling and adjust failing color pairs to WCAG AA. See Modern Web Guidance: adapt-scrollbar-to-contrast-preferences.

findings.evidence: Navigation across the MPA templates is an abrupt full-document swap; authored CSS contains no view-transition rule or @view-transition declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values, with reduced-motion fallback. See Modern Web Guidance: cross-document-transitions.

findings.summary: Add orientation for long directory pages
findings.evidence: The 4,253px mobile home page has no sticky navigation, progress indicator, or scroll-state response; the header simply scrolls away.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight sticky section/progress cue using CSS scroll-state or scroll-driven techniques. See Modern Web Guidance: scroll-progress-indicator.

findings.summary: Expose navigation state and attention cues
findings.evidence: There is no nav landmark or current-location cue, and directory-to-detail navigation changes pages without a focus/visual transition cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic nav, aria-current, headings, and directional transition/focus cues after navigation. See Modern Web Guidance: directional-navigation-transitions.

findings.summary: Reduce repeated header and keyword noise
findings.evidence: On mobile, repeated branding, Telegram copy, bookmarking prompt, and search consume roughly the first 339px of an 800px viewport before page-specific content; pages also append keyword-stuffed tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse repeated promotional chrome and remove keyword-stuffed tags so page-specific content appears first. See Modern Web Guidance: improve-text-layout-and-legibility.

findings.evidence: CSS uses viewport media queries and fixed control dimensions but no authored @container/container-type rules, so reusable components do not adapt to their containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Define containment on reused blocks and use @container rules for local adaptation. See Modern Web Guidance: size-aware-styling.

findings.evidence: Keyboard focus uses the browser outline, but many primary text links have only 17px-high hit areas, well below comfortable touch-target guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44px comfortable hit areas while retaining visible :focus-visible styles. See Modern Web Guidance: accessibility.

findings.evidence: The representative movie path requires sequential listing -> title -> Original -> resolution directory steps before a file action, adding avoidable detours and repeated site chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose available resolutions and the file action on the movie detail page instead of separate directory steps. See Modern Web Guidance: forms.

findings.evidence: A nonexistent route redirects to /movies.php and serves an index-like page rather than a truthful 404 or recovery explanation; invalid form submission relies only on native browser UI with no persistent error summary.
findings.suggestedFix: Return explicit loading/error/not-found states with retry, back, and home actions. See Modern Web Guidance: persistent-toast-notifications.

findings.summary: Bring mobile LCP into the good range
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 4,006ms (score 0.49), outside the good <=2.5s range, although CLS was 0 and TBT 4ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP chain, remove blocking font import/third parties from the critical path, and retest mobile LCP. See Modern Web Guidance: performance.

findings.evidence: HAR confirms two parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheets, including a Google Fonts @import; Lighthouse LCP is 4.0s and BFCache is blocked by no-store caching.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host/preload the needed font or use a system font, cache static assets, and keep third-party scripts out of the critical path. See Modern Web Guidance: optimize-preload-priority.

findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 192,294 of 208,379 bytes; Google Tag Manager alone is 166,828 bytes on a mostly static page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or consent-gate nonessential analytics/ad JavaScript and load it only when needed. See Modern Web Guidance: identify-heavy-scripts.

findings.summary: Align visible and accessible control names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the search button visible text “Search Movie” does not match its accessible name “Submit search”.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the search button accessible name to include its visible “Search Movie” text. See Modern Web Guidance: accessibility.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple WCAG contrast failures: search button 3.67:1, red tags 3.79:1, and Page Tags 2.7:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust blue, red, pink, and white combinations to at least 4.5:1 for normal text. See Modern Web Guidance: accessibility.

findings.summary: Restore semantic page and navigation structure
findings.evidence: Home has no nav landmark, and listing/detail/request templates use styled divs for page titles rather than h1 headings; focus is visible but structure is incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Use h1 for each template title and a nav landmark with current-location semantics. See Modern Web Guidance: accessibility.

findings.evidence: The viewport allows scaling and reflow has no overflow, but many links measure only 17px high, making touch targeting cramped.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase inline link padding/min-block-size without breaking reflow. See Modern Web Guidance: fluid-scaling.

findings.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but the repeated folder SVG lacks width/height attributes; images primitive flags missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width and height attributes to repeated folder images. See Modern Web Guidance: html.

findings.summary: Restore BFCache and resolve inspector issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons caused by Cache-Control: no-store and reports DevTools inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on public pages/static requests where unnecessary and resolve reported inspector issues. See Modern Web Guidance: html.

findings.summary: Replace placeholder links with real destinations
findings.evidence: Viewport and robots are valid, but visible Telegram Channel and active pagination/0-9 controls use href="#", which is not a crawlable destination.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace href="#" placeholders with real URLs or buttons when no navigation occurs. See Modern Web Guidance: html.

findings.summary: Correct canonical and HTTP status signals
findings.evidence: Public pages have no rel=canonical; the requested moviesda32.com permanently redirects to moviesda33.com, and nonexistent paths redirect to an index page rather than return 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit canonical URLs for moviesda33.com and return HTTP 404 for missing content. See Modern Web Guidance: html.

findings.evidence: Movie detail pages provide basic Open Graph text but no JSON-LD entity data and no social preview image.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Movie JSON-LD plus og:image and matching social metadata. See Modern Web Guidance: html.

findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy. See Modern Web Guidance: security.

findings.summary: Minimise tracking and opaque third parties
findings.evidence: The static page contacts six third-party origins, including Google Analytics and an opaque advertising script; third parties account for 92% of transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the opaque ad origin and minimise/consent-gate analytics. See Modern Web Guidance: privacy.

findings.evidence: The response lacks HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; Lighthouse additionally observed third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, frame-ancestors, restrictive referrer/permissions policies, and a third-party-cookie-minimising posture. See Modern Web Guidance: security.

findings.evidence: A missing URL is redirected to /movies.php and presented as a successful content index, with no not-found explanation or recovery context.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a real 404 document with helpful search/home recovery controls and status 404. See Modern Web Guidance: persistent-toast-notifications.

findings.evidence: html lang="en" matches the English UI, but no dir is declared and CSS mixes a few logical properties with many physical left/right margins and paddings, limiting bidi readiness.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare dir and replace physical left/right spacing with logical inline/block properties. See Modern Web Guidance: translator.

findings.evidence: “Join our Telegram Channel” is a dead href="#" control, while the footer “Disclaimer” also links to home; these labels promise destinations they do not provide.
findings.suggestedFix: Point Telegram and Disclaimer labels to their promised destinations or remove/rename them. See Modern Web Guidance: declarative-button-actions.

findings.evidence: A static directory page loads analytics and an opaque ad script; third-party JavaScript accounts for 166.8KB while first-party transfer is only 16.1KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove nonessential analytics/ad work from static page loads. See Modern Web Guidance: deprioritize-background-fetches.

findings.summary: Set and enforce a third-party byte budget
findings.evidence: Five third-party requests transfer 192.3KB of the 208.4KB total, disproportionate to the core static content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, self-host the font, and defer or remove analytics/ad resources. See Modern Web Guidance: efficient-background-processing.
